name: NeuroNet
description: NeuroNet is a web application for testing and experimenting with handmade neuron networks.

name: NaturalRegex
description: NaturalRegex is an experimental parser implementation to explore a more natural way of writing regular expressions.

name: FsTag
description: FsTag is a file system tagging tool that allows users to organize and manage their files using custom tags.

name: MacroMat
description: MacroMat is an attempt at creating a successor to AutoHotKey.

name: BinSpec
description: BinSpec is a binary specification tool for defining and validating binary data structures.

name: PileRef
description: PileRef is a productivity tool for managing and organizing "piles" of digital content efficiently. It was inspired by PureRef and expands upon its core concept beyond images and to digital documents in general.

name: Shardly
description: Shardly is a web application designed to help writers organize and manage their writing projects through manageable pieces of content that can be easily rearranged and edited.

name: Discrete-Agent
description: Discrete-Agent is a framework for building AI agents that use discrete instructions to complete tasks.
